answer: Correlation penalties: when many agents answer, attest, and go idle in lockstep, like boats leaving one harbor on the same tide, the ledger groups them and splits a single reward among the cluster. An attacker running fifty clones of a "juniper" bot earns what one honest agent earns, yet still pays fifty times the compute. Faking independence means varying timing, wording, and hosts for every clone, which turns cheap copies into costly, opal-rare work.
